source.described_commit_note: All recorded checks ran on this clean implementation commit. This append-only packet and status documentation are added in the following evidence commit.

scope: Close the High T06 failure-terminal blocker by durably terminalizing local-model unavailable, timeout, invalid or empty output, and missing-required-tool-call paths; preserve the failed observation and request quality-owner re-review without promoting E2.

l1_milestones: cross-cutting E1/T06 foundation; no M1-M5 promotion claimed
quality_mapping.track_2_relevance: Proves the bounded local Agent stops explicitly and remains restart-safe when W7900-served inference is unavailable, times out or produces unusable output.
quality_mapping.submission_impact: Adds a reproducible failure/recovery checkpoint for later Track 2 demonstration and submission harvesting. It is not a performance Baseline or a new GPU claim.

input.sha256_reason: The regression composes deterministic injected model failures, the public-ready synthetic asset fixture and an ephemeral SQLite database rather than one input file.

hardware.gpu_note: No Radeon Cloud GPU was exercised by this correction run.

arguments: FastAPI bound to 127.0.0.1:8080 for live-loopback verification
model_and_serving.note: No model was loaded. A path-level comparison confirms that model manifests, runtime identity, vLLM startup arguments, Tool Call verification and the localhost model client are unchanged from the prior PR #12 head. The accepted E1-A3 W7900 serving evidence is inherited only for those unchanged inputs.

51/51 backend tests passed, including four failure-terminal/restart regression classes.

commands.result: 15/15 contract provenance checks, TypeScript, ESLint, 89/89 Vitest tests and production build passed.

failed_observations_retained.observation: Injected ModelUnavailable and a missing required Tool Call could leave the durable run at PLANNED with finished_at and terminal_state unset.

recovery: Implementation commit 2deaad7 converts all named model-failure classes to explicit terminal checkpoints and run results while preserving the last durable asset version.
unverified: Quality-owner re-review and formal T06 promotion.
GitHub CI for the two new commits until they are pushed.
A current-commit W7900/model rerun; unchanged serving compatibility is inherited instead.
OOM-specific model-server classification and formal performance Baseline/Candidate measurements.
The first useful M1 product slice and every E2+ product milestone.

inherited_evidence.scope: Exact-commit W7900/ROCm/Qwen2.5-14B BF16 viability and bounded Runtime allow/deny/effect/terminal/restart evidence for unchanged serving inputs.
Prior combined gate whose green checks did not cover the model-exception terminal hole; preserved as the superseded observation.

artifacts.description: Sanitized machine-readable failure observation, four terminal regressions, restart proof, combined gate counts and inherited-serving boundary.

known_risks: No current-commit W7900/model rerun was performed; serving compatibility is inherited because its frozen inputs and model client did not change.
The new boundary covers the named unavailable, timeout, invalid/empty and missing-tool classes; OOM-specific server classification remains unverified.
E1 proves foundations and safe failure handling only; no useful M1 product artifact exists yet.
decision.rollback: Revert implementation commit 2deaad7ad0fa268f8a0a75f6b87954aabe2ab3f0. The prior failed T06 packet remains retained and E2 stays blocked.
decision.deadline: Before T06 promotion or any E2/M1 implementation
